minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, August 16, 2023
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, August 16, 2023.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Lorraine Missick, Bette Donovan,
  Edward Padgett, Jenny Jolly

  Members Absent: Scott Snider and Rafaela Giles.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community Services
  Specialist.

  Guest Present: Members of the Tuesday Morning Bible Reading Group

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, June
  21, 2023, meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: none

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 30 participants per week
  in June and an average of 40 participants per week in July.

  Meals on Wheels: 692 meals served to 42 La Verne recipients in June and 656
  meals served to 44 La Verne recipients in July.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account for the month of July was
  $691.44. The average attendance for May was 65 players per week.

5. Account Balance: $5,351.23

6. Senior Program Fees: All fees have been paid.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Fall session for Mt. SAC will begin August 28, 2023.
 8. Aging Next: June total number of La Verne residents served was 7 and July
  total number of La Verne residents served 10. (via
  Joslyn Center and Aging Next office).

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Eagle Scout will begin a landscaping project at Veterans Hall.
  The City has the opportunity to receive a $75,000 grant through the Perk your
  Park program for Las Flores Park.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Wednesday, August 18 – Senior Seminar: Aging and Vision Loss, Presented by
  Independence at Home 9:30AM
  - Thursday, August 31 – International Line Dancing Party, 10:00AM
  - Wednesday, September 5 – Excursion: Tanaka Farms, 10:00AM-5:30PM
  - Wednesday, September 6 – Senior Seminar: HUD in Reverse Mortgage, Presented by
  Longbridge Financial
  - Saturday, September 9 – Excursion: Pacific Marine Mammal Center and
  Laguna Beach, 10:30AM-6:00PM
  - Monday, September 11 – Movie Matinee, 12:30 PM
  - Wednesday, September 13 – Senior Seminar: Pros and Cons of Reverse Mortgage,
  Presented by Change Home Mortgage
  - Thursday, September 21 – Excursion: Colorful Songs of Broadway Rodgers and
  Hammerstein Show, 10:45AM-4:30PM
  - Monday, September 25 – Health and Resource Fair, 9:00AM-11:30AM

11. Public Comments: Members of Bible group addressed the committee in regards to
  their meeting days. George Borst Sr. reported that the golf league currently has an
  average of 18 players.

12. Adjourn: It was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting at 10:50AM.
  Motion carried. The next meeting will be on Wednesday, September 20, 2023
  at 10:00AM.
